newsitem.title: NORWAY: Orkla result drags down Norwegian bourse.
newsitem.headline: Orkla result drags down Norwegian bourse.

text.p: Branded goods conglomerate Orkla ASA fell more than seven percent on Thursday to drag down the rest of the Oslo bourse after it reported first tertial results.
Orkla said gains in branded goods and its investment portfolio boosted pre-tax profits for the first four months by 35 percent from a year ago to 933 million crowns.
The figures came in above expectations, but analysts said several one-off items, such as portfolio gains of 419 million crowns, had boosted the results.
Orkla's A share tumbled to a low at 561 crowns before closing 7.3 percent down at 568 crowns. The B stock fell to a low at 505 crowns and finished 6.2 percent down at 513 crowns.
"The share fell because and chemicals were weaker than expected. There has not been any growth in volume in the Swedish food market and the catering market is feeling the pressure," said one analyst.
The company accounted for almost 270 million crowns of the market's total turnover of 960 million crowns.
Orkla's plunge led the whole market lower and the Total share index closed 0.73 percent down at 1,168.58 points.
